title: Chapter 374: Aunt
content:
Chapter 374: Aunt

Not only the human race, but almost all the other tribes in the Chaos Realm believe that this is the strong men of their three gods coming to support.

They knew very well how profound the foundation of the Three Gods was.

There was no movement outside the sky for such a long time, and it was obvious that I was preparing to make a big move.

But what they didn't know was that the three gods were also full of doubts at this moment.

They also have no identity for the powerful people outside the sky who suddenly appeared.

If the strong men in their clan return, they will most likely get some news.

However, not.

Perhaps it might be the helpers invited by the powerful men of their gods.

The three gods had the last trace of luck in their hearts and looked at the void heavily.

Click—

A crisp sound of breaking sounded from the depths of the void.

The huge crack expanded a little bit again.

What a strong aura!

The strong men in the Chaos Realm exclaimed in their hearts.

Even An Chang was the three powerful men who also returned from heaven.

"Lord of the Palace, what if it is an enemy?"

An Chang frowned and said with a slightly heavy expression.

They must plan for the worst.

On the side, Wu Shang and Huo Xingzhi didn't say anything, but their faces were also a little bad.

Lu Xue's eyes were calm and she looked at the void faintly. She seemed to be not worried at all. Her fearless look made An Chang calm a little in the hearts of the three of them.

But her hands, which were carrying behind her, were tightly pinched together.

Obviously, Lu Xue did not seem to be calm on the surface.

She is not afraid of death or failure. What she is afraid of is her father's disappointment.

Buzz —

Just then, a sword sounded.

The next moment, the Xuanyuan Sword appeared in Lu Xue's hands.

Looking at the Xuanyuan Sword with a buzzing sound in his hands and a majestic sword, Lu Xue's expression trembled.

She suddenly rose up from the ground, rushed into the void like a meteor, and stood above the human race.

In an instant, all human races, regardless of gender, strength and weakness, looked up at Lu Xue.

Their eyes were filled with reverence without exception.

Everyone heard Lu Xue whisper: "Human race, help me!"

The sound fell.

The human race responded one after another.

In an instant, the human race felt a faint aura leaving the body, heading straight towards Lu Xue in the void, ready to say that it was the Xuanyuan Sword in Lu Xue's hand.

Looking down at the void, I saw countless lines of luck gathering into the Xuanyuan Sword.

At the same time, the breath of Xuanyuan Sword began to surge wildly.

This sword will be unprecedentedly powerful.

Even now, Lu Xue's cultivation is still a little low.

But this sword is a sword that represents the luck of the human race!

Lu Xue was so imposing at this moment that she wanted to shout at this moment, "After this sword, the human race will be worry-free."

However, she didn't know how strong the outsider was.

Can my sword be the opponent?

If she can't, she can only cheat.

In just a few seconds, it seemed like a century had passed.

Under the horrified eyes of countless creatures, a beautiful woman, holding the mysterious city in her hand, slowly walked out of the crack in the space and officially stepped into the Chaos Realm.

At this moment, the world seemed to have been pressed.

After the silence, a huge cry came.

That is the call from the human race.

This powerful man from heaven is a human race.

And how happy the human race is, how heavy the three gods are.

"Ah!!! Damn it, damn it!!"

The head of the Heavenly God Clan has no longer been as calm as it was at the beginning, and instead he has a look of hideousness and reluctance.

On the side, the two patriarchs of the Divine Power Clan and the Divine Blood Clan were the same, but more of them were still a little desperate.

In this case, how should they fight against the human race?

Did they really be abandoned by God?

For a moment, the entire small world of the God Clan was covered with a thick layer of despair, as if he could never turn over.

On the other side, within the human race.

An Changzai beside Lu Xue let out a heavy sigh.

They had thought that this powerful man from the sky would be their friendly force, but when this happened, it felt really dreamy.

Isn't it a bit too smooth?

The three of them turned their heads and looked at Lu Xue, and were about to speak, but they were stunned.

Lu Xue was looking at the woman standing in the void at this moment, and to be precise, she looked at the city held in the woman's hand.

She stared blankly, and for a moment, she didn't say a word.

"Lord of the Palace, you,"

A drop of clear tears slid from the corner of Lu Xue's eyes.

Lu Xue cried with joy.

Dad always gives her unexpected surprises.

And the woman in the void is naturally Jiang Xiaoxiao who has just taken back to the deserted city.

Seeing Lu Xue's gaze, Jiang Xiaoxiao felt something and looked in the direction of Lu Xue suddenly.

For a moment, the eyes met.

Jiang Xiaoxiao couldn't help but be shocked.

Like, so similar.

If she could recognize the wrong person, she would commit suicide on the spot.

laugh!

Space shock.

Jiang Xiaoxiao suddenly disappeared from the spot.

When it appeared again, it had appeared not far in front of Lu Xue.

An Chang was shocked in the hearts of the three of them. This strength is probably far above them.

At this time, Jiang Xiaoxiao had already walked slowly towards Lu Xue.

The three of them heard Jiang Xiaoxiao chuckling and said, "You are Xiaoxue, right?"

Lu Xue flashed her big watery eyes and smiled at Jiang Xiaoxiao.

"I wonder who is senior?"

Jiang Xiaoxiao had already walked to Lu Xue at this moment. She couldn't help but hold Lu Xue's hand, put it in the palm of her hand, and said softly, "I am your aunt."

aunt!

An Chang was surprised in the hearts of the three of them.

There is indeed no ordinary person in this family.

"Aunt, where are my father and my mother?"

Lu Xue had no doubt about this suddenly appeared aunt.

The deserted city in her hand is the best proof.

Hearing this question, Jiang Xiaoxiao looked at the deserted city in her hand and then threw it into the void with force.

Suddenly, the deserted city began to grow rapidly. In a blink of an eye, a giant city covering the sky was floating above the human race, and the sacred aura continued to baptize every creature in the human race.

Everyone looked at the huge city above their heads, their eyes full of shock.

Buzz —

At this time, an abnormal movement came from the deserted city.

The film wrapped outside the deserted city gradually dissipated.

Figures rose into the sky from the deserted city and appeared in everyone's eyes.

With just one glance, Lu Xue saw Yan Lingyun standing in front of the crowd.

"mother!"

Lu Xue smiled and rushed towards Yan Lingyun quickly.

At this time, Yan Lingyun was also looking at Lu Xue, with a loving smile in her eyes.

"Xiaoxue, how are you doing lately?"

"Mom, I'm fine. Haven't you seen my dad?"

In response, Yan Lingyun shook her head, with a hint of helplessness on her face.

"Your father, I don't know where to go to wander."

Lu Xue smiled awkwardly and stopped asking more questions.

At this time, a shocking dragon roar suddenly sounded in the deserted city.
